visualCharacteristics.purpose: Third-party iframe players such as YouTube videos or a walls.io social wall
visualCharacteristics.layout: One row of columns; 2 cells become halves, 3 become thirds; wall is full width
notable: A cell with only a link becomes an iframe (href is the src, link text is the title)
Other cells render as rich text with buttons
wall variant renders an 800px tall scrolling social wall

contentPattern.structure: One row with one cell per column; a cell holding only a link becomes a player, any other cell stays rich text
contentPattern.rows: Single row, one or more cells

usage: Use to embed YouTube videos or a social wall from an external URL
reuseGuidance: Fits iframe-embeddable third-party URLs; not for self-hosted media files or audio
